children: The European Central Bank said Thursday that executive board member Isabel Schnabel would step down from the role early to join the International Monetary Fund.

Schnabel, who is member of the six-person executive with responsibility for market operations, will become the IMF's Financial Counselor and Director of the Monetary and Capital Markets Department, the ECB said.

The ECB said Schnabel would step down on Jan. 3, 2027, and would remain a rate-setting member of its executive and governing council until transitioning to the new role. Her eight-year term at the ECB was due to end in December 2027.
The move comes at the cusp of a reshuffle of the top team at the central bank. ECB President Christine Lagarde is due to complete her term next year.
